newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list First Financial, NUKO options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list First Financial, NUKO options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said it would begin trading options on shares of First Financial Corp of Wisconsin on February 28 and on NUKO Information Systems Inc on March 3.

First Financial options would have opening strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with initial expirations in March, April, June and September, the exchange said. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
Penn Options has been named specialist unit.
The stock ended down 3/8 at 27-5/8 Wednesday.
NUKO options would open with strikes of 5, 7-1/2 and 10. Initial expirations would be in March, April, May and August.
Position limits have been set at 7,500.
TFM Investment Group has been named the specialist.
NUKO shares finished unchanged at 8-1/4 Wednesday.
